correctness.rationale: For all sigma>0 and kappa>epsilon>0, exact eigenvalues give a nonzero Hopf crossing speed. The quadratic center manifold yields h11=-2c|a|^2/sigma, and removing quadratic terms yields nu=|a|^2(2d-2c^2/sigma-2c/omega)=-sigma Delta^3[sigma(kappa+4epsilon)+4Delta]/[2 kappa^2(1+sigma^2 Delta)]<0. The Hopf theorem proves existence, local uniqueness, stability and the stated leading signal radius. The package checker passed generic symbolic identities and independent three-dimensional multilinear calculations at three rational parameter sets. No global attractor assertion is made.

value.rationale: The original paper demonstrated the positive-forcing Hopf threshold analytically and supercritical onset numerically for one parameter set. Proving its sign throughout the admissible saturation and damping parameter domain, ruling out generalized Hopf on both threshold surfaces, and identifying the exact physical amplitude prefactor closes a natural bifurcation-classification gap with direct quantitative relevance.
